about: Secondary progression sign ingresses of the Sun and Moon, one day after birth for each year of life (365.2422 days), from the Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03 (Moshier, no files), for births drawn by the app at a fixed now of 2026-11-05T00:00Z. last and next are years after birth; lon is the progressed longitude now.
